situations.title: 천식 악화 초기 문진
situations.tagline: My asthma's been acting up and my inhaler isn't helping much.
situations.brief: 유발인자·조절제 사용·악화 빈도를 청취해 천식 악화를 초기 문진하세요.
keyPhrases: What set off your asthma this time?
How many times have you used your rescue inhaler today?
Do you take a daily controller inhaler?

situations.title: 최고호기유속(PEF) 측정 설명
situations.tagline: How do I use this little tube thing you're handing me?
situations.brief: 최고호기유속(PEF) 측정법을 시연하고 기준 대비 협조를 유도하세요.
keyPhrases: Take a deep breath in, then blow out as hard and fast as you can.
We'll do it three times and take the best number.
This shows how open your airways are right now.
goals: 기준치 대비 결과를 협조 속에 얻는다

situations.title: 흡입기 사용법 확인·교육
situations.tagline: I press it and breathe in, but I'm never sure I'm doing it right.
situations.brief: 스페이서 사용과 타이밍을 시연하며 흡입기 사용법을 확인·교육하세요.
keyPhrases: Shake it, then attach it to the spacer like this.
Press once, then breathe in slowly and hold for ten seconds.
Let's have you show me so I can check your technique.

situations.title: 네뷸라이저 치료 설명
situations.tagline: What's in this mist mask, and how long do I breathe it?
situations.brief: 살부타몰 네뷸라이저의 목적과 부작용을 설명하며 치료를 안내하세요.
keyPhrases: This mist is a medicine that opens up your airways.
Breathe normally through the mask until it's finished.
It may make your heart race or hands shake a little.

situations.title: COPD 기저질환 병력
situations.tagline: I've had COPD for years and I'm on home oxygen most of the day.
situations.brief: 흡연력·산소 사용·악화 빈도를 청취해 COPD 기저질환 병력을 정리하세요.
keyPhrases: How long have you been on home oxygen, and at what flow?
Do you still smoke, or when did you quit?
How often do you end up in the hospital for flare-ups?

situations.title: 중등도 발작 반응 사정
situations.tagline: I've had a few treatments — am I breathing any better yet?
situations.brief: 연속 분무 후 PEF와 증상 변화를 재사정해 중등도 발작의 반응을 평가하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's recheck your peak flow after these treatments.
Is it easier to speak in full sentences now?
Your numbers are improving — that's a good sign.
goals: 연속 분무 후 PEF와 증상을 재사정한다
치료 반응에 따라 다음 조치를 판단한다

situations.title: COPD 악화 유발 감염 감별
situations.tagline: My cough's worse, the phlegm changed color, and I'm more winded than usual.
situations.brief: 객담·발열·심부전 등을 확인해 COPD 악화의 감염 유발 여부를 감별하세요.
keyPhrases: Has the color or amount of your phlegm changed?
Have you had a fever or chills?
Any swelling in your legs or trouble lying flat?
goals: COPD 악화의 감염 유발 여부를 감별한다
심부전 등 다른 악화 원인을 배제한다

situations.title: 스테로이드 시작 설명
situations.tagline: Steroids? I've heard those have a lot of side effects.
situations.brief: 전신 스테로이드의 목적과 기간을 설명해 천식·COPD 악화 치료를 안내하세요.
keyPhrases: A short course of steroids calms the swelling in your airways.
You'll take them for about five days, not long term.
It helps you recover faster and prevents a rebound.

situations.title: 말하기 힘든 호흡곤란 중증도
situations.tagline: I... can't... finish... a sentence...
situations.brief: 단어 단위 발화·보조근 사용을 확인해 호흡곤란 중증도를 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: Just nod or shake your head — don't try to talk.
I can see you're using your neck muscles to breathe.
We're starting continuous treatments right now.
goals: 발화 능력과 보조근 사용으로 중증도를 사정한다

situations.title: COPD 산소 목표 88–92%
situations.tagline: My oxygen feels low — shouldn't you crank it up higher?
situations.brief: CO2 저류 위험을 설명하며 COPD 산소 목표 88–92%를 유지하도록 소통하세요.
keyPhrases: For COPD, we aim for 88 to 92 percent, not higher.
Too much oxygen can build up carbon dioxide for you.
I'll titrate it carefully to keep you in that safe range.

situations.title: 흡연 중단 상담 연계
situations.tagline: I know I should quit smoking... maybe this scare is my wake-up call.
situations.brief: 악화 시점의 동기를 활용해 흡연 중단 상담으로 연계하세요.
keyPhrases: This flare-up could be a good moment to quit for good.
There are medications and support that really help.
Would you like me to connect you with a quit program?
goals: 악화 시점을 활용해 금연 동기를 강화한다

situations.title: 언어장벽 악화 핵심
situations.tagline: No... aire... inhalador... no funciona.
situations.brief: 언어장벽 악화 환자에게 예/아니오로 흡입기·알레르기·발열을 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: Used your inhaler today? Yes or no?
Fever? Yes or no?
Allergy to medicine? Interpreter is coming.
goals: 폐쇄형 질문으로 악화 핵심 정보를 확인한다

situations.title: 약물 순응 실패 반복 악화
situations.tagline: I stopped using my daily inhaler — I only grab the rescue one when it's bad.
situations.brief: 조절제 미사용 등 약물 순응 실패를 확인해 반복 악화의 원인을 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: How often do you actually use your controller inhaler?
Relying only on the rescue inhaler leads to more flare-ups.
What makes it hard to take the daily one?
goals: 조절제 미사용 등 순응 실패를 파악한다
순응 실패와 반복 악화의 관계를 확인한다

situations.title: 소아·청소년 천식 보호자
situations.tagline: My son's wheezing is scaring me — what triggers should I watch for?
situations.brief: 보호자에게 트리거와 응급 징후를 교육하고 소아 천식 관리를 안내하세요.
keyPhrases: Common triggers are smoke, dust, pets, and colds.
Watch for fast breathing, ribs pulling in, or blue lips.
Give the rescue inhaler and come back if it doesn't help.

situations.title: 심부전 동반 호흡곤란 감별
situations.tagline: They said I have both asthma and a weak heart — how do I know which is acting up?
situations.brief: 심장천식과 기도 원인을 구분해 심부전 동반 호흡곤란을 감별하세요.
keyPhrases: Is it worse when you lie flat or at night?
Have your ankles been swelling or your weight going up?
We'll listen to your heart and lungs to tell them apart.

situations.title: 중증 발작 급속 악화
situations.tagline: *gasping* ...it's not working... I can't... breathe...
situations.brief: SpO2 급락 중증 발작에서 마그네슘 투여와 삽관 가능성을 준비하세요.
keyPhrases: We're giving continuous treatments and magnesium now.
Stay with me — we're doing everything to open your lungs.
If this doesn't turn around, we may need to breathe for you.

situations.title: 조용한 흉부(silent chest) 위기
situations.tagline: Her wheezing suddenly stopped — but she looks worse, not better.
situations.brief: 천명 소실(silent chest)을 임박 호흡정지의 경고로 인지하고 즉시 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: The wheezing stopped because almost no air is moving.
This silent chest is a warning she's tiring out.
Call the team — prepare for intubation now.
goals: 천명 소실을 임박 호흡정지 경고로 인지한다
즉각적인 삽관 준비와 팀 동원을 조율한다

situations.title: COPD 고탄산 호흡부전 BiPAP
situations.tagline: He's getting drowsy and confused — his CO2 must be climbing.
situations.brief: 의식 혼탁을 동반한 COPD 고탄산 호흡부전에서 BiPAP 적용을 조율하세요.
keyPhrases: His drowsiness likely means rising carbon dioxide.
Let's start BiPAP and watch his mental status closely.
If he doesn't improve, we'll escalate to intubation.

situations.title: 천식 지속상태 삽관 준비
situations.tagline: Nothing's working — she's exhausted and we may have to intubate.
situations.brief: 난치성 천식 지속상태에서 RSI를 보조하고 삽관을 준비하세요.
keyPhrases: She's in status asthmaticus and tiring quickly.
Draw up ketamine and the paralytic for RSI.
Expect difficult ventilation — we'll manage her pressures.

situations.title: 긴장성 기흉 합병 COPD
situations.tagline: His right chest isn't moving and his pressure just tanked.
situations.brief: COPD 환자의 편측 악화에서 긴장성 기흉을 인지하고 흉관·감압을 대비하세요.
keyPhrases: No breath sounds on the right and a crashing pressure — think tension pneumo.
Prepare for immediate needle decompression.
Set up a chest tube kit right now.
goals: COPD 편측 악화에서 긴장성 기흉을 인지한다
흉부 감압과 흉관 삽입을 신속히 대비한다

situations.title: 임박 호흡정지 SBAR 이송
situations.tagline: He's barely breathing and about to give out — I need the team now.
situations.brief: 임박 호흡정지 환자의 활력·발화·의식을 SBAR로 보고하고 이송을 조율하세요.
keyPhrases: Situation: severe COPD flare, now barely responsive.
Sats are 82 on max therapy, one-word answers only.
I recommend immediate intubation and ICU transfer.

situations.title: 인공호흡 이력 중증 재발
situations.tagline: I was on a ventilator last time — please don't let it get that bad again.
situations.brief: 인공호흡 이력을 확인해 고위험 환자로 인지하고 조기 공격적 치료를 개시하세요.
keyPhrases: Have you ever been on a breathing machine for your asthma?
That history means we treat you aggressively from the start.
We're starting strong treatments early to stay ahead of it.
